item.title: DPS to conduct sobriety checkpoints
item.description: (DPS) — The CNMI Department of Public Safety will be conducting two separate sobriety checkpoints on Saturday, Dec. 20, 2025. The post DPS to conduct sobriety checkpoints appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: USAFA’s Maratita selected as sole STEP promotee for 2025
item.description: (Press Release) — The United States Air Force Academy and the 10th Air Base Wing proudly announce the STEP or Stripes for Exceptional Performers promotion of Technical Sgt. Consuelo C. Maratita, assigned to the 10th Medical Group, 10th MDSS in Colorado Springs, Colorado. The post USAFA’s Maratita selected as sole STEP promotee for 2025 appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Ruel Nava and Marc Raagas shine at Paskong Pinoy celebration
item.description: RUEL Nava, a supervisor at Ace Hardware in Gualo Rai, won the 2025 Paskong Pinoy “Kwarta o Kahon” (Cash or Box) contest held Sunday at the Marianas Business Plaza parking lot. The post Ruel Nava and Marc Raagas shine at Paskong Pinoy celebration appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: CNMI eyes continued WICHE membership
item.description: THE CNMI government is reviewing its continued membership in the Western Interstate Commission for Higher Education. The post CNMI eyes continued WICHE membership appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Governor nominates Dave Guerrero, Michael Evangelista to NMC board
item.description: GOVERNOR David M. Apatang last week nominated Commonwealth Economic Development Authority Economic Development Manager Dave Guerrero and Zoning Board member Michael N. Evangelista to the Northern Marianas College Board of Regents. The post Governor nominates Dave Guerrero, Michael Evangelista to NMC board appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: DLNR chief, 2 others plead not guilty to misconduct charges
item.description: DEPARTMENT of Land and Natural Resources Secretary Sylvan O. Igisomar, acting Division of Fish and Wildlife Director Rosemary C. Camacho, and DFW Conservation Officer Ignacio I. Yiftheg all pleaded not guilty Monday morning to charges stemming from the alleged personal use of an agency boat and vehicle. The post DLNR chief, 2 others plead not guilty to misconduct charges appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Pedestrian struck by pickup truck in critical condition
item.description: A 57-year-old man is in critical condition at the Commonwealth Healthcare Corporation’s Intensive Care Unit after being struck by a pickup truck Sunday evening in Garapan. The post Pedestrian struck by pickup truck in critical condition appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: $25M Aggreko costs included in CUC FAC petition
item.description: THE Commonwealth Utilities Corp. is preparing to file a formal petition with the Commonwealth Public Utilities Commission to reconcile its long-delayed Fuel Adjustment Charge, including a request to recover an estimated $25 million in Aggreko rental-generation costs. The post $25M Aggreko costs included in CUC FAC petition appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: ‘It’s time to be honest with the retirees’
item.description: THE CNMI government cannot afford to pay the 25% of retirees’ pensions, Finance Secretary Tracy B. Norita told lawmakers last week. The post ‘It’s time to be honest with the retirees’ appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: No tsunami threat for CNMI
item.description: HSEM: The time stamp is supposed to be 9:25 AM, not 9:25 PM. The post No tsunami threat for CNMI appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.
